description: NOT ENABLED. A script-free SessionEnd hook for when the server lets kt_session_end address a session by the client's own id. Today kt_session_end needs the OpenKT session_id, which only the model holds, and mcp_tool hook input can only template fields of the hook's own JSON (the Claude Code session_id). To use: have kt_session_start accept client_session_id, have kt_session_end accept it in place of session_id, then merge this block into hooks.json.
